senses.gloss: m. (v. נָדַן) a bride’s outfit, given by her father; wedding equipment.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 74b:3">B. Mets. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>יהיב זוזי לנ׳ וכ׳</he> paid a stipulated amount for an outfit to be delivered at the house of his daughter’s father-in-law; <he>לסוף זל נ׳</he> in the meanwhile the value of the equipment was reduced (and the father-in-law refused to receive it for the value stipulated).
<cite ref="Ketubot 54a:22">Keth. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא … נ׳ לברת</he> a man in his dying bequest defined the nature of the equipment for his daughter.
